label: Editorial Split
description: Content on one side, heading and supporting text on the other. Blocks placed by layout role.

layoutSlots.description: Section title and intro (renders at top of content column). For a sidebar-style label heading, place a Section Heading in the supporting-text slot instead.
Main content blocks (stack vertically in content column)
Sidebar or supplementary content (renders in chrome column). Accepts Section Heading for label-column patterns (category, date, section label).
Image or media blocks (render in content column, alongside editorial body)
Image or media blocks (render in sidebar/chrome column, alongside supporting text)
Call-to-action blocks (render at bottom of chrome column)

settings.label: Show Divider
settings.description: Adds a vertical line between content and sidebar columns

settings.label: Block Spacing
settings.description: Space between blocks within this section

settings.label: Sidebar Position
settings.description: Controls vertical alignment of the sidebar relative to content

options.label: Follow Scroll
options.description: Sidebar stays visible as you scroll past main content

options.label: Centered
options.description: Sidebar is vertically centered next to content

options.label: Top
options.description: Sidebar aligns to top of content area

options.label: Bottom
options.description: Sidebar aligns to bottom of content area

settings.label: Typography Scale
settings.description: Scales all headings within this section

settings.label: Top Edge Shape
settings.description: Decorative SVG separator at the top of this section, filled with the section background so the colour flows into the section above.

settings.label: Bottom Edge Shape
settings.description: Decorative SVG separator at the bottom of this section, filled with the section background so the colour flows into the section below.

settings.label: Divider Height
settings.description: Height of the shape dividers on this section.
